protocol.method: TF-IDF cosine over catalog.parquet processed_text; vectoriser fit on catalog_train.parquet, L2-normalised; no ALS, no popularity, no personalisation
protocol.sample_frame: numpy.random.default_rng(seed), uniform without replacement over catalog nids present in data/processed/indo/interactions_train.parquet, then sorted (deterministic)
protocol.coview_definition: candidate and query share >= 2 TRAIN accounts (distinct dummy_user_id); a pair sharing at least one account is necessary but not sufficient
protocol.coview_threshold_variant_definition: same but >= 1 shared TRAIN account (sensitivity check on the threshold; not the headline)
protocol.interpretation_limit: Co-view at this corpus scale is structurally sparse (600 accounts, ~4.1 mean TRAIN views per item), so coview_recall cannot discriminate systems; category_match against the random baseline is the usable signal.
protocol.random_baseline: k items drawn uniformly without replacement from the full catalog with the same RNG stream; query item excluded
protocol.category_match: fraction of the k returned items whose catalog `category` equals the query's category
protocol.coview_recall: fraction of the k returned items that are co-viewed with the query
